intro.text: A member of House Hammondess who represents it in the Elendel Senate.

items.text: Mari was named to the select council Steris proposed to deal with the Outer Cities. In its closed meeting she argued that Elendel should strike first while it could still win. When a message revealed a bomb aimed straight at Elendel, she immediately made plans to flee the city with her family.

appearance.text: Considered attractive, with flawless skin, delicate features, long eyelashes and a small gap between her front teeth.

personality.text: Well informed about Basin politics and something of a war hawk. Faced with danger, she puts her own family's safety ahead of the city's people.
